title: Towards Measuring Representational Similarity of Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on measuring representational similarity of LLMs using various technical measures (e.g., Orthogonal Procrustes, Jaccard similarity) on datasets like Winogrande and HumanEval. While the introduction mentions 'alignment of model behavior with human goals' as a high-level motivation for studying LLM similarity, the paper does not conduct specific evaluations or benchmarking related to religion, morals, or ethics.
